import PV_L2C_ReferenceArithmetic
import PV_L2C_SubPrimitive
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_NormalizeSource
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9 PV_L2C_ReferenceArithmetic

/-- The exact final comparison/subtraction cut common to both extracted ops. -/
def normalize (s : U32) : Result U32 :=
  if s≥aspis_core.field.P then ok (U32.wrapping_sub s aspis_core.field.P) else ok s

theorem wrap_eta (s : U32) : wrap s.bv=s := by cases s; rfl
#print axioms wrap_eta

theorem modulus : aspis_core.field.P=wrap (BitVec.ofNat 32 PV_L2C_M31.p) := by
  unfold aspis_core.field.P
  rfl
#print axioms modulus

theorem normalize_native (s : U32) :
    normalize s=ok (wrap (PV_L2C_M31.subtractP s.bv)) := by
  rw [PV_L2C_M31.subtractP_branch]
  have hc : (s≥aspis_core.field.P) ↔ PV_L2C_M31.p≤s.bv.toNat := by
    rw [modulus]
    rfl
  unfold normalize
  by_cases h : s≥aspis_core.field.P
  · rw [if_pos h,if_pos (hc.mp h),modulus,PV_L2C_SubPrimitive.wrapped_sub]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg h,if_neg (fun h' => h (hc.mpr h')),wrap_eta]
#print axioms normalize_native

theorem sub_input (x y : U32) :
    (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add x aspis_core.field.P) y).bv=
      x.bv+BitVec.ofNat 32 PV_L2C_M31.p-y.bv := by
  rw [modulus,PV_L2C_SubPrimitive.wrapped_add,PV_L2C_SubPrimitive.wrapped_sub]
  rfl
#print axioms sub_input

theorem sub_cut (x y : U32) :
    aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y=
      normalize (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add x aspis_core.field.P) y) := by
  unfold aspis_core.field.M31.sub
  generalize U32.wrapping_add x aspis_core.field.P = a
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  generalize U32.wrapping_sub a y = b
  rfl
#print axioms sub_cut
end PV_L2C_NormalizeSource

import PV_L2C_NormalizeSource
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_ReferenceSub
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9 PV_L2C_ReferenceArithmetic
open PV_L2C_NormalizeSource

theorem m31_sub (x y : U32) :
    aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y=ok (wrap (PV_L2C_M31.sub x.bv y.bv)) := by
  calc
    _ = normalize (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add x aspis_core.field.P) y) := sub_cut x y
    _ = ok (wrap (PV_L2C_M31.subtractP
        (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add x aspis_core.field.P) y).bv)) := normalize_native _
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun w => ok (wrap (PV_L2C_M31.subtractP w))) (sub_input x y)
#print axioms m31_sub
end PV_L2C_ReferenceSub

import PV_L2C_ReferenceSub
import PV_L2C_NativeQ
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_ReferenceQ
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9
open PV_L2C_ReferenceArithmetic PV_L2C_NativeQ
abbrev RawQ := aspis_core.field.QM31

def source (q : Q) : RawQ :=
  ⟨⟨wrap (q 0),wrap (q 1)⟩,⟨wrap (q 2),wrap (q 3)⟩⟩
def model (q : RawQ) : Q := fun i =>
  if i.val=0 then q.c0.a.bv else if i.val=1 then q.c0.b.bv
  else if i.val=2 then q.c1.a.bv else q.c1.b.bv

theorem source_roundtrip (q : RawQ) : source (model q)=q := by
  rcases q with ⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩
  cases a; cases b; cases c; cases d
  rfl
#print axioms source_roundtrip

theorem model_roundtrip (q : Q) : model (source q)=q := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl
#print axioms model_roundtrip

theorem source_zero : source zero=aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO := by
  unfold aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
  rfl
#print axioms source_zero

theorem add_source (x y : Q) :
    aspis_core.field.QM31.add (source x) (source y)=ok (source (addQ x y)) := by
  simp only [aspis_core.field.QM31.add,aspis_core.field.CM31.add,source,
    PV_L2C_ReferenceArithmetic.m31_add,bind_tc_ok] <;> rfl
#print axioms add_source

theorem sub_source (x y : Q) :
    aspis_core.field.QM31.sub (source x) (source y)=ok (source (subQ x y)) := by
  simp only [aspis_core.field.QM31.sub,aspis_core.field.CM31.sub,source,
    PV_L2C_ReferenceSub.m31_sub,bind_tc_ok] <;> rfl
#print axioms sub_source

theorem add_actual (x y : RawQ) :
    aspis_core.field.QM31.add x y=ok (source (addQ (model x) (model y))) := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← source_roundtrip x,← source_roundtrip y]
  exact add_source _ _
#print axioms add_actual

theorem sub_actual (x y : RawQ) :
    aspis_core.field.QM31.sub x y=ok (source (subQ (model x) (model y))) := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← source_roundtrip x,← source_roundtrip y]
  exact sub_source _ _
#print axioms sub_actual
end PV_L2C_ReferenceQ

import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Fin
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_FirstInactive
/-- Literal first_inactive_row scan: None records the public all-active panic
case, rather than silently installing a successful selector. -/
def first : List Bool → Option Nat
 | [] => none
 | false::_ => some 0
 | true::xs => (first xs).map Nat.succ

theorem returned (xs : List Bool) (i : Nat) (h : first xs=some i) :
    i<xs.length ∧ xs[i]?=some false := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp [first] at h
  | cons b bs ih =>
    cases b with
    | false =>
      simp only [first,Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst i
      exact ⟨by simp, rfl⟩
    | true =>
      cases ht : first bs with
      | none => simp [first,ht] at h
      | some j =>
        simp only [first,ht,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] at h
        subst i
        obtain ⟨hb,hv⟩ := ih j ht
        exact ⟨by simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ hb,by simpa using hv⟩
#print axioms returned

theorem table_returned {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Nat)
    (h : first (List.ofFn active)=some d) : ∃ hd : d<n, active ⟨d,hd⟩=false := by
  obtain ⟨hb,hv⟩ := returned (List.ofFn active) d h
  have hd : d<n := by simpa using hb
  refine ⟨hd,?_⟩
  have he : (List.ofFn active)[d]?=some (active ⟨d,hd⟩) := by simp [hd]
  rw [he] at hv
  exact Option.some.inj hv
#print axioms table_returned
end PV_L2C_FirstInactive
